scripts.test:all: pnpm --if-present --filter './packages/common' --filter './packages/observability' --filter './services/core-api' --filter './services/email-provider' --filter './services/storage' --filter './frontend/cruip-landing' run test && pnpm run test:generated && pnpm run verify:generated && pnpm run test:release-gate
scripts.verify:docs: pnpm run test:docs && node scripts/verify-doc-authority.mjs && redocly lint docs/openapi.yaml
scripts.test:release-gate: node --test scripts/smoke/fake-email/server.test.mjs scripts/verify-smoke-artifacts.test.mjs scripts/verify-release-gate.test.mjs && bash scripts/smoke-core-mode.test.sh && bash scripts/smoke-core-health.test.sh && bash scripts/smoke-core-artifacts.test.sh
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter './packages/common' --filter './packages/observability' --filter './services/core-api' --filter './services/email-provider' --filter './services/storage' --filter './frontend/cruip-landing' exec tsc -b --pretty false && pnpm run typecheck:e2e
